notes.title: 3D Escape Room: Mystic Manor Demo Now Available!​
notes.notes:
Good morning, good afternoon, and good evening, players!

We are thrilled to announce that the free demo for [b][i]3D Escape Room: Mystic Manor[/i][/b] is now live! Additionally, we will be participating in the Steam June Next Fest to meet you all at this gaming extravaganza!

[b]Wishlist now ↓↓↓[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3612480/3D_Escape_Room_Mystic_Manor/

[h2]Demo Highlights[/h2]

The demo version of [b][i]3D Escape Room: Mystic Manor[/i][/b] includes two complete levels with approximately 45 minutes of gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45595209/a30abc911577bae0355239c095cb0d2bdd28b698.gif[/img]

The full version will feature 16 uniquely styled rooms, over 12 hours of gameplay, and hundreds of puzzles/mini-games encompassing logic deduction, mathematical calculations, item combinations, and more...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45595209/d7d8a7b7ac4ad919d4ca6372f9910087d1baaadf.gif[/img]

In our game, you'll unlock an additional visual dimension - manipulating mechanical structures inside objects through vision to discover hidden clues invisible to the naked eye!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45595209/db05fd22ecf8c80d1073ac0aa7179df227704c4d.gif[/img]

Moreover, the game rooms authentically recreate specific historical eras and local cultural elements. We've seamlessly integrated these beautiful visual components with puzzle challenges, allowing you to enjoy exploring exquisite scenes while solving mysteries!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45595209/50c06bcada418af120a7f26af4f780ea40bf9c9a.gif[/img]

Experience the free demo of [b][i]3D Escape Room: Mystic Manor[/i][/b] now and get a head start on this thrilling puzzle-solving adventure!

notes.title: The "3D Escape Room" series is about to release its third installment!
notes.notes:
Good day, players!

Today we're thrilled to announce the next installment in the 3D Escape Room series – [i][b]3D Escape Room: Mystic Manor[/b][/i] is coming soon!

In the game, you inherit your grandfather's legacy - a manor. While exploring this manor, you discover unspeakable secrets hidden within.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45366309/a30abc911577bae0355239c095cb0d2bdd28b698.gif[/img]

Driven by curiosity, you open door after door in the ancient mansion, follow clues, solve magnificent puzzles and mechanisms, and attempt to uncover the truth buried beneath this ancient manor.

[list]
[*][b]Mind-Bending Puzzles[/b]

The game includes 16 uniquely styled rooms, over 12 hours of gameplay, hundreds of puzzles and mini-games covering logical reasoning, mathematical calculations, item combinations, and more... Various types of puzzles are perfectly integrated with the story. Use your keen observation and powerful logical reasoning to solve these exciting puzzles and sharpen your wisdom!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45366309/d7d8a7b7ac4ad919d4ca6372f9910087d1baaadf.gif[/img]

[*][b]Magical X-Ray Eyepiece[/b]

In our game, you will unlock another visual dimension! Manipulate internal mechanical structures by seeing through object surfaces and discover mysterious clues invisible to the naked eye!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45366309/db05fd22ecf8c80d1073ac0aa7179df227704c4d.gif[/img]

[*][b]Breathtaking Graphics & 3D Visuals[/b]

The rooms in the game authentically recreate specific historical eras and local cultural elements from the story's setting. We've combined these beautiful visual elements with puzzle challenges, allowing you to enjoy exploring these exquisite scenes while solving puzzles!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45366309/50c06bcada418af120a7f26af4f780ea40bf9c9a.gif[/img]

[/list]
Additionally, enjoy a 20% launch discount for the first two weeks! Don't miss this chance – add to your wishlist now↓↓↓

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3612480/3D_Escape_Room_Mystic_Manor/

notes.title: Detective Story Demo is Here!
notes.notes:
Good morning, good afternoon, and good evening, players!

We are thrilled to announce that the free demo for our new game, [b][i]3D Escape Room: Detective Story[/i][/b], is now available! Additionally, we will be participating in Steam's February Next Fest, where we’ll meet you all at this grand gaming celebration!

[b][h2]Demo Highlights[/h2][/b]
The demo for [b][i]3D Escape Room: Detective Story[/i][/b] includes the first chapter of the full game, offering approximately 45 minutes of gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45366309/0905451950ea329a0550d8fbad916c6499a873b3.gif[/img]

In the full version of the game, you will travel back to 1930s London, stepping into the shoes of a renowned detective to solve a series of baffling cases. The game features diverse escape room settings, such as a spy hotel, the Orient Express, and a countryside cottage, immersing you in the unique charm of that era.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45366309/349ed3583ea6bb4664265ba134651c7ef28f8533.gif[/img]

The game boasts stunning 3D models paired with captivating background music, creating a hyper-realistic environment that draws you in. All you need is your keen observation skills and strong logical reasoning to uncover clues in each intricately detailed room, solving hardcore puzzles and challenging mini-games.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45366309/b491197f64c4a79fe12ce4896c01ca6bc2dd6d01.gif[/img]

Download and play the free demo of [b][i]3D Escape Room: Detective Story[/i][/b] now, and get a sneak peek into this thrilling puzzle-solving adventure!

notes.title: The 3D Escape Room series is about to have a new installment.
notes.notes:
Good morning, good afternoon, and good evening, dear players!

Today, we have a great piece of news to announce: the next installment in the 3D Escape Room series - [i][b]3D Escape Room: Detective Story[/b][/i] is coming soon!

Unlike the previous games, the story of [i][b]3D Escape Room: Detective Story[/b][/i] takes place in London in the 1930s. In the game, you will play as an extremely perceptive private detective, searching for clues in realistic 3D scenes, solving elaborate puzzles and mini-games, and cracking a series of mysterious cases.

[list]
[*][h2]Fantastic Mechanism Designs[/h2]

From the spy's suitcase to the piano-playing automaton, and to the mechanical globe with hidden secrets, we have added more unique mechanisms in this installment, combining art and logic, waiting for you to uncover their secrets with your own hands.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45296512/167a6157429a6060325f1734e536b9bcaabdec71.jpg[/img]

[*][h2]Realistic Retro Aesthetics[/h2]

Unlike the Chinese rooms, in this installment, we are committed to depicting the retro charm of 18th-century London. Whether it is the retro hotel during the espionage period, the luxurious Orient Express, or the idyllic countryside cottage, each scene has been carefully crafted, hoping to bring you the charm of history and a strong sense of immersion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45296512/e90108013901b51dd4c19cd8a7fa065882614782.jpg[/img]

[*][h2]A Large Number of Brain-Teasing Puzzles[/h2]

This time, we have increased the length of the game and the difficulty of the puzzles, hoping to bring more intellectual challenges to the players. From password cracking to mechanism unlocking, every step requires in-depth thinking and careful deduction. It is recommended that you prepare pen and paper to help record clues and solve the puzzle challenges in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45296512/3e5e5bf91264ac3eee7c54888662b1eebba5fee5.jpg[/img]
[/list]
In addition, we will offer a 20% discount for the first two weeks as the launch discount. Friends who are interested, don't miss this opportunity. Add it to your wishlist quickly ↓↓↓


https://store.steampowered.com/app/3411050/3D_Escape_Room_Detective_Story/
